design_brief_zh: 主卖点聚焦铝合金拉杆，并以“三档高度调节＋顶部隐藏式可折叠手机支架”形成可验证的功能链路。PC画布为2000×2000：产品严格置于左侧区域[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]，采用略低机位的正侧面三分之四角度，完整呈现箱体、拉杆和顶部结构；右侧文案区固定为[0.57,0.10,0.38,0.80]，保留整洁低饱和背景，并为德语预留约20%扩展空间。用一个实体拉杆位置和两个轻微半透明位置轮廓，共同直观表达三档高度；在拉杆顶部增加局部放大视窗，展示手机支架由隐藏到展开的结构，手机仅作使用场景道具，不暗示随箱附赠。移动端1200×1200需单独重排：上方产品场景位于[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，主体居中并放大拉杆动作；底部文案区位于[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]。阅读层级依次为：标题强调铝合金拉杆与三档调节；支持说明串联调节动作和展开支架；细节1对应拉杆材质近景；细节2对应顶部支架放大图。产品外观、竖条纹、金属框架、颜色和结构必须与实物参考一致，不混配不同变体。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影风格、浅灰与暖白中性环境、侧上方自然柔光，以窄边缘高光突出金属拉杆，避免过度镜面反射。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线体，标题以深蓝粗体，正文深灰，细节可用橙色细线连接对应结构；数字“三档”优先清晰呈现。
compliance_note_zh: 文案仅使用已提供并可验证的事实：拉杆为铝合金材质、具有三档调节、顶部带隐藏式可折叠手机支架。不得补充承重、耐久测试、人体工学、设备兼容范围或认证信息；手机仅作为场景道具，不得暗示包含在包装内。图片不得使用竞品标识、评分、促销角标、绝对化表述或官方背书。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium modern European travel-product visual for the YWJ suitcase, using the uploaded product reference as the strict source for shell shape, vertical grooves, aluminum frame, telescopic handle, corner construction, color, and proportions. PC master canvas 2000x2000: place the full suitcase in the left product region x 5–51%, y 8–92%, viewed from a slightly low three-quarter front-side angle so the telescopic handle and top assembly are clearly visible; preserve clean negative space in the right region x 57–95%, y 10–90% for later copy placement. Make the aluminum-alloy telescopic handle the visual focal point with controlled metallic edge highlights. Show exactly three handle-height states through one solid current position plus two subtle translucent positional overlays, aligned to the same handle rails. Add a refined macro inset near the handle top showing the concealed fold-out phone holder in its opened state; include a generic smartphone with a blank neutral screen only as a usage prop, not as included equipment. Use a low-saturation warm gray and off-white environment, soft natural daylight from the upper side, realistic shadows, restrained navy and orange graphic accents without labels, and an upscale editorial travel-photography finish. Prepare a mobile-safe adaptation for 1200x1200 with the product scene centered in x 8–92%, y 5–58% and uncluttered negative space below in x 5–95%, y 64–95%. No rendered text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, icons, watermarks, promotional graphics, invented components, or competitor branding.
